text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A trainer with no trainees has one
job—getting to know new students.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I get to the tracks, I spot Agnes
Digital running the dirt course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's small, but she's sturdy and seems to
have a lot of leg strength.
In the blink of
an eye, she blasts down the final straight
and crosses
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital, that was great! You were in
top form, as always. At this
level, you're
more than ready to take on the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwah?! The tryouts? Already?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But I, uh... That's kinda... Could I have
more time to think about it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll, uh, I'll just scooch over to the turf
course...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If you insist. Don't push yourself too
hard, though!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
To think that she trains this hard every
single day... and then turns
around and
does it again on the other track. She's
working twice as
hard as anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Agnes Digital sets off down the turf, I'm
taken aback by how light
her steps are. I
thought she was a dirt racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I whip out my stopwatch to check her time,
and my jaw drops.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's good on turf and dirt, but she hasn't even run the tryouts yet, let alone debut?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My curiosity gets the better of me, and I
head over to ask her
directly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fweheehee... Running on the same ground
my oshis just stepped on is
so magical!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I can just follow their cleatprints, I'll be
ready to follow them down
any track!
Mwehehe, I'll follow them to the ends of
the earth...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I've gotta be careful not to stick
out. I dunno what I would've
done if I
accidentally agreed to enter the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'd never forgive myself if I made
such a rookie mistake...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: W-WAIT! Who just said that? You?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're that trainer who was simping as
hard as I was. Looks like
we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So how's everything going? Lady Luck
rewarding your efforts?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've been working hard to rack up good
karma, y'know. Praying to my
merch
shrine, giving thanks for my daily doses of
moe, ugly crying
over idols...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-but more importantly! You didn't, uh,
happen to overhear me
rambling, did
you?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see. I see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, the reason I'm avoiding the tryouts is
honestly pretty simple.
Just imagine your
Umamusume oshis for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
They specialize in either turf or dirt, right?
But I don't really have a
specialty, and I
have favs in both.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's the hardest part... I can't pick one
without abandoning the
other. And I
really, reeeeeally don't want that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The graded races at central racecourses
are mostly for turf, especially
at higher
levels.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lot of racers inevitably drift away from
dirt, so I get what Agnes
Digital means.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well, of course! I love watching both styles! I love turf Umas and dirt Umas! I love every single Umamusume ever to run!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, um. It ain't easy bein' a fangirl,
okay?! I've got way too many
favs to watch
just one track type!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Duh! I thought you were as down bad as I
am! I wanna watch both! I
have to, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I run turf, I won't be able to see dirt
Umas up close! If I run dirt, I
won't get to
see turf Umas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahdk, how is that even fair?! I can't
come up with a solution, so
I've been
turning down all the scouts and tryout
invites to stall for
time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna SIMP! Whether on turf or dirt,
I wanna absorb the glory of
eeeeevery
single Umamusume from the frontlines!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I can't help but feel like she's
seeing things as a fan more than
a racer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But at least you get me! You feel my pain,
right?! 'Cause you love
Umamusume too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I attempt to calm Agnes Digital down,
then I take stock of the
situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to follow her favorite "oshi"
Umamusume, but debuting as a
racer
herself will limit what kind of races she can
join.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can't pick between dirt or turf, so
she's been dodging the
question by
rejecting scout offers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... If I had a clear specialty, it'd be so much easier to accept the inevitable...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's already spent so long thinking
herself in circles. Maybe what
she really
needs is a second opinion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? We can't just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I peek down at the course, where I spot
the Overlord of turf racing,
T.M. Opera O,
and the idol of dirt racing, Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...What.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
WHAT?! That's the Overlord and the
Umadol!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My, what fervent gazes. Are you perhaps
here to see me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I welcome you both! I'm always happy to
pose for photos, answer
questions, record
interviews—anything for my adoring fans!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's quite a unique question. The
answer is simple, really. For
you see—I
simply chose the stage best suited to
complement my
glory!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I know you... You're Digital! Thank
you for cheering me on at my
last
performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so flattered to see you here at the
track! ♪ You must be a really
big fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The reason I picked dirt over turf?
Hmm... Well... I promised
myself that I'd be
my best self and do what only I can! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though their phrasing differs, both
answers are essentially the
same. They
picked a style that would show off their
talents best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now to apply that to Agnes Digital...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...As the grass follows the wind, so too
does luck follows the virtuous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On that cryptic note, she passes out... Did
I just witness someone
swoon in real life?
